name: folder-preview
description: Lists all pages in the current folder. Used in auto-generated and user-created folder index pages.

detect.note: This stylesheet OWNS the .fp-card* card grid, and theme templates render that markup directly without any folder-preview container — alter-engineers' pages/tags.njk builds a .fp-cards grid by hand. Detecting only the container classes dropped the stylesheet on every tag page, collapsing the 3-column grid to a full-width unstyled stack. Same failure mode as article/.share-bar: a stylesheet can own classes something else renders.
